snippet.title: Netherworld C64 longplay Part 1/5
snippet.description:
Here's yet another game I loved as a kid. This is not by far a perfect playthrough, I get lost many times and I even lose a life at one point as I forget to pick up some damn hourglasses.
I get lost easily in games and this one is pretty damn confusing at times :)

This is part 1/5 due to Youtubes 10 minute limit.
